bullets.text: Gigabit IQ Crowdfunding Success - **Gigabit IQ** seeks £270,000 to enhance its online safety-focused ISP services, with £243,650 already committed.
NCSC Cybersecurity Alert - The **NCSC** warns UK infrastructure is under threat from Russian DDoS attacks, urging improved defenses.
AI Revolution in Telecom - **Actifai** introduces AI solutions to enhance broadband sales processes, promising significant ROI for providers.
Telenor's Major Exit - **Telenor** sells its stake in Thailand's True Corporation for $3.9 billion, reducing its Asian footprint.
Liberty Global's Acquisition Talks - **Liberty Global** is negotiating to buy **Three Ireland** for up to €1.5 billion, aiming for market consolidation.
Open Cosmos Satellite Launch - **Open Cosmos** successfully launches its first satellites for a new LEO constellation, enhancing European connectivity.
AI Infrastructure Investment Surge - Telecom operators are increasingly investing in AI infrastructure to meet rising demand and regulatory requirements.
Wi-Fi 7's Bright Future - **Cisco** predicts 2026 will be a pivotal year for **Wi-Fi 7** adoption as device readiness aligns with market demand.
5G Broadcast Demonstration - **Rohde & Schwarz**, **Qualcomm**, and **Motorola** showcase 5G Broadcast capabilities, marking a milestone in mobile TV delivery.
Private 5G Security Gaps - Bridging security gaps in **Private 5G** networks is crucial for protecting enterprise infrastructures from cyber threats.
